summary: This 8-K/A by Parks! America, Inc. amends a prior filing to correct an entity name and remove language regarding accounting treatment. It discloses a refinancing transaction where a subsidiary completed a $2.33 million term loan modification with Cendera Bank, maturing June 1, 2033, at SOFR+2.70% (initial 6.34%), fixed to 6.99% via a rate conversion agreement. The loan removes a $2.5 million cash collateral reserve and includes standard covenants. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
